title: Loupe
description: A 1909 baseball card on the desk and a collector's loupe in your hand. Turn the glass up from 2× to 20× and the photo comes apart into what it really is: CMYK rosettes slightly out of register, ink bleeding into paper fibre, and a crease that cracked the print.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: real glass over a real print, where magnification turns a picture into the physical ink it is made of.
